scripts.test: find src -name '*.test.ts' | grep -q . && bun test || echo 'No tests found'
scripts.compile: bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 src/index.ts --outfile dist/monzo-linux-x64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 src/index.ts --outfile dist/monzo-darwin-arm64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 src/index.ts --outfile dist/monzo-windows-x64.exe
